与舞蹈风格匹配的音乐，节奏鲜明，旋律有起伏，在舞蹈高潮时音乐强度拉满，结束姿势时音乐骤停或余音缭绕，营造舞蹈表演的舞台感。

If the prompt text and a reference image disagree, the reference image WINS. The output character's face MUST look like the person in <Picture 1>@图1 — same eyes, nose, mouth, skin tone, eyebrow shape, hairline, hair color, hair texture, and facial proportions. The output outfit MUST look like the clothing in the outfit reference picture — same garment type, same sleeves, same hem length, same color, same pattern, same texture, same buttons/zippers/pockets, same collar, same waistline, same accessories. If the reference image shows a specific outfit, the video shows THAT exact outfit — not a different color, not a different pattern, not a different cut. [STRICT MULTI-REFERENCE COMPLIANCE / 严格多参考声明]: EVERY <Picture N> referenced in this prompt is an independent reference and MUST be strictly followed — face, hairstyle, clothing, body proportions, accessories and weapon/prop must be preserved EXACTLY per its OWN <Picture N>. NEVER follow only one reference image while ignoring the others: every referenced <Picture N> must take effect. 本提示词中出现的每一个 <Picture N> 都是独立的参考图，必须逐一严格遵循其各自的面部、发型、服装、体型、配饰与道具，严禁只参考其中一张而忽略其他任何一张；所有被引用的参考图都必须完整生效。
